title: athyrium lanceum
intro: Athyrium lanceum, commonly known as the lady fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the Athyrium genus. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Athyrium lanceum include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral properties, which help to alleviate symptoms of respiratory problems, fever, and other infections. The bioactive constituents of Athyrium lanceum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and improving immune function.
